source_text: Table 4: Allele frequencies of Kdr mutations in An. gambiae s.l. Akoun N=100, R=1, S=0. Abstract: Only test survivors were used for Kdr mutation testing by PCR... Diagnostic PCR for the Kdr mutation showed that 100% of the survivors had the mutation in both sites, with frequencies of the resistant allele of 1.0 in both species.
